ruleDefinitions.name: Remote Access Tool - ScreenConnect Remote Command Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of a system command via the ScreenConnect RMM service.

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\ScreenConnect\\\.ClientService\\\.exe$") AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "Cmd\.Exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\TEMP\\\\ScreenConnect\\\\.*"))
